title: Unit 18 Consolidation: Digital Sovereignty, Algorithmic Surveillance & Information Security
goal: I can talk about digital sovereignty, critical networks, surveillance and encryption in Hungarian.
I can use concession and reservation, *elengedhetetlen* + infinitive, stance phrases, *annak függvényében, hogy …* and *nem annyira …, mint inkább …*.
I can say what a short text says about Kalmár László and thinking machines.
